about: Places where a private marker may appear (docs/DESIGN.md#store-and-packaging): the LICENSE copyright line, package.json's author, the publisher's display name, and the commit author (commit author and committer fields are never scanned). A rule applies to whole lines of one file that match its pattern, and only to the markers it names. File paths are always scanned without rules.

rules.reason: Random base64 in package integrity hashes can spell a short marker by chance.
